# measured age

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:measuredAge`](gmeow-measuredAge.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/measuredAge>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/temporal`](../../slices/temporal.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The numeric age yielded by a temporal measurement, in the unit given by [`gmeow:hasUnit`](gmeow-hasUnit.md).

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use for a measurement that yields an elapsed-time figure (years before present, sample age) rather than an absolute calendar date — the radiocarbon/geologic style of result.

### Avoid when

- Avoid for an absolute calendar instant (use [`gmeow:measuredDate`](gmeow-measuredDate.md), which feeds the [`periodStart`](gmeow-periodStart.md) chain) and avoid omitting [`gmeow:hasUnit`](gmeow-hasUnit.md); a bare number without a unit is ill-formed.

### How to use

- Write an [xsd:decimal](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#decimal) age and always pair it with [`gmeow:hasUnit`](gmeow-hasUnit.md); record spread with [`gmeow:measurementUncertainty`](gmeow-measurementUncertainty.md); converting an age to an absolute date is a solver-layer concern (P12), so age does not trigger the [`periodStart`](gmeow-periodStart.md) chain.

### Examples

- ex:charcoalDate [`gmeow:measuredAge`](gmeow-measuredAge.md) "4200"^^[xsd:decimal](http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#decimal); [`gmeow:hasUnit`](gmeow-hasUnit.md) <http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/YR>.
